use_case_name: Publish Subsurface Surveillance and Acoustic Contact Reports

claims.content: To report subsurface surveillance tracks and acoustic bearings/ranges derived from ASW sensors via J3.4 Subsurface (Maritime) Track and J5.4 Acoustic Bearing/Range messages.

goal.raw_text: To report subsurface surveillance tracks and acoustic bearings/ranges derived from ASW sensors via J3.4 Subsurface (Maritime) Track and J5.4 Acoustic Bearing/Range messages.

claims.content: C2 JU
Tactically significant subsurface surveillance information derived from ASW sensors (bearings, ranges, or tracks) is available to be exchanged.
For subsurface track reporting, the source of track data is available for the Source TN and all data to be reported are time tagged.

For acoustic bearing/range reporting, bearing/range information derived from ASW sensors is available, and the position of the acoustic bearing origin and the applicable Origin TN for the detecting sensor are known.

Where a subsurface track is reported under a Track Number, the C2 JU has assumed reporting responsibility for that Track Number because it was the first JU to report the contact, or one of the allowed exceptions applies (a J7.0 Drop Track message containing the TN has been received, or a J3.4 message containing the TN has not been received for two consecutive periodic updates).

Tactically significant subsurface surveillance information derived from ASW sensors—an established local track at the next reporting opportunity or acoustic bearing/range information—is to be exchanged.

claims.content: C² JU provides the source of track data as the Source TN.
C² JU time tags all Subsurface surveillance track data.
C² JU reports established local tracks with all known parameters at the next reporting opportunity using the J3.4 Subsurface (Maritime) Track message.
C² JU reports the geodetic latitude and longitude for each Subsurface surveillance track in the J3.4 message and specifies depth when available.
C² JU reports the velocity of Subsurface surveillance tracks as course and speed, with speed in data miles per hour of ground speed and course in degrees with respect to true north.
C² JU exchanges track identity using the Identity field and may report Platform and Platform Activity in the J3.4I message.
C² JU uses the J5.4 Acoustic Bearing/Range message to exchange information on bearings (ambiguous and resolved) and/or range derived from ASW sensors.
C² JU sets the J5.4E0 Latitude and Longitude fields to the position of the acoustic bearing origin and reports bearings from the detecting sensor origin.

If the detecting sensor is integral to the reporting JU, C² JU sets the J5.4C2 Origin TN field to the TN of the reporting JU (a towed array is considered integral to the ship); if the detecting sensor is integral to another unit, track, or point being reported, C² JU sets the Origin TN field to the TN of the detecting unit, track, or point.

2a. If contact is lost and the operator decides to report the track as a DATUM, C² JU reports a J3.4 message with the same Reference TN as the track for which contact has been lost, sets Data Report Type (DRT) = 4 (DATUM), sets ASW Time Function = 3 (Time Contact Lost) or 1 (Time Datum Established), sets Hour and Minute to the truncated time contact was lost or DATUM established, and includes Latitude, Longitude, and 15 Meters Depth; the decision to report a DATUM is an operator function.
2b. If contact is regained after a DATUM, C² JU reports a J3.4 with DRT set to value 0, 1, or 2 using the same TN as the DATUM, or a new TN depending on operator action.

2c. If another JU has already reported the contact under a Track Number and either a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message containing the TN is received or a J3.4 message containing the TN has not been received for two consecutive periodic updates, C² JU may report the contact using that track number.

2d. If C² JU believes a contact is the same contact reported by another JU using a different TN, C² JU may report it using a different TN; when this is done, only locally derived data shall be reported in the J3.4 message, and the J3.4 messages shall not contain data derived only by the reception of remote data from other IU(s) reporting the same contact.

2e. If C² JU determines that a Subsurface IU is no longer active on the interface and C² JU also holds local data on the IU, C² JU assumes R² by reporting a J3.4 Subsurface (Maritime) Track message using the inactive IU address as the reference TN.
2f. If further refined information concerning a subsurface fix or one of the other ASW points may result in a Subsurface surveillance track, C² JU reports the track with a new TN.

2g. When associating Subsurface surveillance data, C² JU performs manual correlation of Subsurface surveillance data; the correlation procedures specified for Air, Surface (Maritime), or Land (Ground) tracks are not applied to Subsurface tracks.
2h. If operational necessity requires a shorter wait time or none at all, an override is allowed; system design should also allow for longer wait times.
